history.notes: IN TARGET / OUTSIDE now work together with VOCAL / INST: right click both to hear only the part of the voice (or the instruments) inside or outside the target. The BUY button opens the Visualize page directly.

New MONITOR picture: what is lost when the mix is played in mono, a target shape and a score - IN TARGET / OUTSIDE to see (left click) or hear (right click) only those parts. IMAGE redrawn: each sound a cloud - loud sounds in front, echo and reverb trail behind, wide sounds spread out. CYLINDER is now called VECTOR. A short tour on first start (the ? in Settings shows it again) and RETURN ALL TO DEFAULT in Settings. Loudness: the big number is the whole song. 3D pictures turn freely by dragging, the mouse wheel or the arrow keys. Smaller buttons, faster drawing and less delay.
